name: Shimai Ecchi ~Ore ga Kyoushi de Ani de Tanin de~
original_name: 姉妹えっち～俺が教師で兄で他人で～
source:
Hideki is a PE teacher at a high school. One day, he goes to the principal room to meet transfer students. But they are his relatives, Madoka and Yuka...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090415004218/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005581]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
秀树是一所高中的体育老师。一天，他去校长室迎接转学生。然而她们竟是他的亲戚——圆和由香……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090415004218/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005581]Eroge Shop[/url]]
